title: The fail-closed ungoverned-opt-out condition, as structured violations
intent: The gate refuses to honour any opt-out marker when no escape-hatch budget governs it — an ungoverned opt-out would be an invisible one. This rule is that same fail-closed condition projected as structured findings (one per marker line), so a structured renderer reports it in-band instead of crashing the harness.
reference: assert_app_clean raises on an ungoverned # arch-allow-* marker; ungoverned_marker_violations projects the same condition as ArchViolation values for terp check --format json.

runtime.rationale: A justification marker is a source comment; compiled bytecode retains neither the marker nor its reason. The escape-hatch contract governs authored source at the gate.
